## Professional Overview
Sumit Rathor (also referenced as Sumit Rathore) is a Full Stack Software Engineer and B.Tech graduate in Computer Science & Design from Madhav Institute of Technology & Science (MITS), Gwalior. He specializes in designing, building, and deploying modern web applications, real-time communication systems, AI-powered developer utilities, and IoT hardware platforms.

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Languages:** JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, PHP, Python, SQL, C++, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Frontend Frameworks & Libraries:** React.js, Next.js, Vite, Bootstrap 5, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, SweetAlert2.
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, Express, PHP, CodeIgniter 4, RESTful APIs, AJAX, WebSockets.
- **Databases & Cloud:** MySQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth, RLS, Realtime), Hostinger, Vercel.
- **IoT & Hardware:** ESP32-CAM, Arduino, Computer Vision, L298N motor drivers.
- **AI & Automation:** OpenAI API, Google Gemini API, Automated ATS resume parsing, QR verification engines.
- **Developer Tools:** Git, GitHub, Postman, Linux CLI, NPM, VS Code.

## Flagship Projects

1. **Certificate Authentication & Verification Portal**
   - High-performance React application for live camera QR code certificate authentication and bulk Excel-to-QR generation with automated ZIP export.
   - Stack: React, JavaScript, PDF.js, SheetJS, Google Apps Script API.
   - Live URL: https://innovation-and-diy-certificate.vercel.app/

2. **Hardware Inventory & Borrowing Portal**
   - Campus inventory and borrowing system featuring domain-restricted Gmail OTP authentication, Supabase Row-Level Security, and atomic stock transactions.
   - Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, Supabase PostgreSQL, Supabase Auth, Nodemailer, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
   - Live URL: https://innovation-and-diy-inventory.vercel.app/

3. **11acre.ai - Real Estate & PropTech Platform**
   - Commercial real estate portal with category filtering (buy/rent/plots), multi-attribute property search, and buyer-agent onboarding workflows.
   - Stack: CodeIgniter 4, MySQL, AJAX, REST APIs, JavaScript.
   - Live URL: https://11acreai.in/

4. **FPV Surveillance Robot**
   - Wireless teleoperation robot with real-time first-person-view video streaming, sub-second movement controls, and ESP32-CAM firmware integration.
   - Stack: ESP32-CAM, C++, L298N, Computer Vision, REST API.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/sumitrathor1/FPV_Car
   - Live URL: https://sumitrathor.rf.gd/FPV_Car/

5. **Data Science Quiz & Skill Assessment Platform**
   - Timed technical evaluation engine covering Python, ML, and Statistics with instant score calculation, detailed solutions, and admin performance analytics.
   - Stack: PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Bootstrap.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/sumitrathor1/Data-Science-Quiz
   - Live URL: https://sumitrathor.rf.gd/Data-Science-Quiz/

6. **Smart Resume - AI Resume Builder**
   - Interactive resume platform with ATS-friendly templates, OpenAI/Gemini integration, section reordering, and PDF export.
   - Stack: PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Gemini API, Bootstrap.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/sumitrathor1/smartresume
   - Live URL: https://sumitrathor.rf.gd/smartresume/

7. **VibeTune - Music Streaming Platform**
   - Modern audio platform supporting AJAX-based continuous playback, track upload workflows, dynamic playlist curation, and responsive glassmorphism UI.
   - Stack: PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, AJAX, Bootstrap.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/sumitrathor1/VibeTune
   - Live URL: https://sumitrathor.rf.gd/VibeTune/
